page.title: Messages
page.description: WhatsApp connection, automatic notification rules and message templates.
templates.title: Message and notification templates
templates.description: Edit the title and text per channel for every notification type. Untouched templates use the system default.
templates.read_only: Only the business owner can edit templates.
editor.title: {{type}} template
editor.description: Click a placeholder to insert it. The preview updates live with sample data.
editor.subject: Title
editor.subject_hint: WhatsApp and SMS messages do not include the title.
editor.active_hint: A passive template disables this channel for the notification.
editor.reset_confirm: Reset this template to the system default?
editor.test_hint: Sends the saved Turkish WhatsApp template with sample data.
prefs.title: My notifications in this business
prefs.description: Choose which notifications you receive on which channel. WhatsApp and SMS need a phone number.
prefs.phone_hint: The business WhatsApp line sends messages to this number.
prefs.phone_required: Enter a phone number before enabling WhatsApp or SMS.
prefs.error: Notification preferences could not be loaded.
prefs.default_hint: Default: in-app on, WhatsApp on when a phone is set.
daily_summary.title: End-of-day summary
daily_summary.description: At closing time the day's summary is sent over WhatsApp to the people you select: vehicles served per service, revenue (cash / card / account), unpaid jobs, expenses and cash balances.
daily_summary.not_connected: WhatsApp is not connected. The summary is sent from the business WhatsApp line; connect it above first.
daily_summary.send_time_hint: Turkey time; the day's summary is sent once at this time.
daily_summary.recipients_hint: The summary includes revenue and cash figures; select authorised people only. It goes to each person's notification phone.
daily_summary.no_phone_hint: Cannot be sent to people without a notification phone: {{names}}.
daily_summary.no_phone_link: Add it under Profile → notification settings.
daily_summary.preview_hint: Preview of the WhatsApp message with today's data.
daily_summary.errors.WHATSAPP_NOT_CONNEC: WhatsApp is not connected; connect it first.
daily_summary.errors.NO_RECIPIENT_PHONE: None of the selected recipients has a notification phone.
daily_summary.errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid settings: select at least one recipient and enter the time as HH:MM.
daily_summary.errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
vehicle_alerts.title: Vehicle alerts (team)
vehicle_alerts.description: When a vehicle is accepted, delivered or cancelled, the selected team members are notified. In-app and web push are instant; members without web push get a WhatsApp message from the business line.
vehicle_alerts.not_connected: WhatsApp is not connected: recipients without web push only get in-app notifications. Connect WhatsApp above for WhatsApp messages.
vehicle_alerts.frequency_hint: Batched options send all activity in the window as one message (for busy locations). In-app notifications are always instant.
vehicle_alerts.no_services: No active services in the catalog.
vehicle_alerts.recipients_hint: Staff get vehicle details; amounts are shown to owners only.
vehicle_alerts.no_channel_hint: People without web push or a notification phone only see alerts in the app: {{names}}.
vehicle_alerts.no_channel_link: Add a phone or enable push under Profile → notification settings.
vehicle_alerts.test_skipped: WhatsApp not sent (no phone or WhatsApp not connected): {{names}}
vehicle_alerts.errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid settings: select at least one event and one recipient.
vehicle_alerts.errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
